import MumfordLib.SimplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex

/-!
# Transport of cochain Mayer--Vietoris exactness

The simplicial Mayer--Vietoris sequence is an actual short exact sequence of
cochain complexes. This file records the precise comparison interface needed
to transfer its homology exactness to another model, such as ordinary singular
cohomology. The comparison maps are explicit isomorphisms of the three terms;
the commutative squares are hypotheses, so this bridge does not hide the
small-chain comparison theorem.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex)

/-- Exactness transfers across isomorphisms of the three terms of a short
complex. The two displayed equalities are the commutative-square conditions.
The resulting theorem is useful when the comparison isomorphisms come from a
separate quasi-isomorphism argument.
-/
theorem exact_of_simplicialCohomology_iso
    {T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat ℤ)} (n : ℕ)
    (e₁ : T.X₁ ≅
      ((simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex A B).map
        (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).X₁)
    (e₂ : T.X₂ ≅
      ((simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex A B).map
        (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).X₂)
    (e₃ : T.X₃ ≅
      ((simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex A B).map
        (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).X₃)
    (h₁ : e₁.hom ≫
        homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B) n = T.f ≫ e₂.hom)
    (h₂ : e₂.hom ≫
        homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B) n = T.g ≫ e₃.hom) :
    T.Exact := by
  let S := (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex A B).map
    (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)
  let eS : T ≅ S := ShortComplex.isoMk e₁ e₂ e₃ (by
    change e₁.hom ≫ homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B) n =
      T.f ≫ e₂.hom
    exact h₁) (by
    change e₂.hom ≫ homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B) n =
      T.g ≫ e₃.hom
    exact h₂)
  exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_iso eS).mpr
    (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_pair A B n)

end Mumford.Analytic
